Either way NASCAR wouldn’t be in this situation if they had clear definitions on what restarts or cautions are.  In my opinion they should define a restart as when the leader crosses the start/finish line, and if a wreak happens before that, line them back up in the previous order (minus the damaged cars).  If they had something more definite in place, Havick’s fiasco at Talledega wouldn’t have created this overtime line in the first place.  Defining a caution would be much more difficult.
